newsitem.title: FINLAND: MERITA CEO HAS NO COMMENT ON MERGER TALKS.
newsitem.headline: MERITA CEO HAS NO COMMENT ON MERGER TALKS.

text.p: Finnish banking group Merita Oy's CEO Vesa Vainio said on Thursday the bank would make no further comment on last year's talks about cooperation with insurers Sampo and Pohjola .
"We will not make any further comment on talks that have ended," Vainio told a Reuters reporter, referring to a statement issued by Merita earlier on Thursday.
He declined any comment on potential future talks.
Vakuutusosakeyhtio Sampo and Merita said in separate statements on Thursday they had been in talks about cooperation, but the talks had ended without results.
Merita said it had also been in talks about cooperation with Vakuutusosakeyhtio Pohjola, but that these talks, too, had now ended.
"Both talks have ended without results," Merita said.

Daily Helsingin Sanomat reported on Thursday that talks between Merita and Sampo had ended without agreement. The negotiators had failed to agree on the terms for exchanging Sampo shares for Merita shares, the paper said.
They had also concluded that a merger would not lead to any significant benefits, it said.
